museum: Museo Etnográfico Juan B. Ambrosetti (Universidad de Buenos Aires)
sources_checked: Marchegiani, Reynoso, Ammirati & Estevez 2020, Arqueología 26(3): 85-110 (full text PDF https://revistascientificas.filo.uba.ar/index.php/Arqueologia/article/download/8747/7602); momias.equiponaya.com.ar/articulos/ramomias2b.htm
queries: WebSearch 'Museo Etnográfico Ambrosetti colección egipcia momia animal cocodrilo'; PDF grep cocodril|crocod|animal|ibis|halc|gato
result_detail: Egyptian collection comprises 3 wooden coffins, 'dos momias de animales' = one cat-shaped and one falcon-shaped bundle (lote Nº 1896/3552, donation Delfina S. de Viglione 1896; X-rayed: falcon bundle contains bird bones; cat bundle mineralized remains). No crocodile.
notes: Fuscaldo 1978, 'Estatuillas y animales momificados', Rev. Inst. Hist. Antigua Oriental 4: 87-95 publishes the animal mummies.

museum: Iziko South African Museum / Iziko Museums of South Africa (Social History Collections)
sources_checked: https://www.iziko.org.za/?s=mummy ; https://www.iziko.org.za/?s=crocodile ; https://egyptinsouthafrica.iziko.org.za/mummifiedobjects/ ; .../artifactsarrivinginsa/ ; .../egyptianartifactsatiziko/ ; Cornelius, Swanepoel, du Plessis & Slabbert 2012, Akroterion 57: 129-148 (https://egyptinsouthafrica.iziko.org.za/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/09cormumfin.pdf)
result_detail: Iziko's Egyptian collection (~500 objects; Petrie Tarkhan, Amarna, Brunton Mostagedda) holds five animal mummies, all CT-scanned at Stellenbosch: 2 complete birds, 1 falcon-shaped bundle with a leg/talons, 1 fake bird-shaped bundle, 1 probable kitten. No crocodile.
notes: Egyptian collection formerly at South African Museum, transferred 1966 to SA Cultural History Museum (Slave Lodge). Official Egypt in South Africa site lists other SA holders of Egyptian material: Albany Museum (Grahamstown/Makhanda), Durban Natural Science Museum, National Museum of Cultural History Pretoria (Ditsong).
